units.source_text: 我的论文在教授眼里，似乎不像我自己评价的那么好。

en.t: In the professor's eyes, my thesis apparently was not as good as I had judged it to be.

units.source_text: 尽管如此，我的论文还是按照预想通过了。

en.t: Even so, my thesis passed just as expected.

units.source_text: 毕业那天，我穿上了从行李中找出的发着霉味儿的旧冬装，

en.t: On graduation day, I put on an old winter outfit that smelled of mildew, which I had found in my luggage,

units.source_text: 站在礼堂的队列里时，每个人的脸上都热气腾腾的。

en.t: as I stood in the line in the auditorium, every face looked flushed with heat.

units.source_text: 我的身子裹在不透气的厚呢绒里，热得受不了。

en.t: My body was wrapped in thick woolen cloth that let no air through, and the heat was unbearable.

units.source_text: 站了不大工夫，手帕就擦湿了。

en.t: After standing there only a short while, my handkerchief was soaked from wiping sweat.

units.source_text: 毕业典礼一完，我马上跑回宿处，脱光了衣服，

en.t: As soon as the graduation ceremony ended, I ran back to my lodgings and stripped off all my clothes,
opened the second-floor window of the lodging house,

units.source_text: 把毕业证书卷成一个望远镜似的圆筒，尽情地眺望了一番圆筒中所看到的景色。

en.t: rolled my diploma into a telescope-like tube and gazed to my heart's content at the view seen through it.

units.source_text: 然后，把那张证书扔在桌上，

en.t: Then I tossed the certificate onto the desk,

units.source_text: 四仰八叉地躺在了房间正中央。

en.t: and lay sprawled on my back in the very center of the room.

units.source_text: 我这么躺着，回顾自己的过去，想象自己的未来。

en.t: Lying there like that, I looked back on my past and imagined my future.

units.source_text: 于是，觉得这张区分过去与未来的毕业证书，既像是有意义的，又像是没意义的一张奇怪的纸。

en.t: Then this diploma, which divided past from future, seemed to me a strange piece of paper, meaningful and meaningless at the same time.

units.source_text: 那天晚上，我受邀到先生家吃晚饭。

en.t: That evening, I was invited to Sensei's house for dinner.

units.source_text: 这是早就约好了的，毕业那天的晚饭不能去别处吃，要在先生家里吃。

en.t: This had been arranged long before: on graduation night I was not to eat anywhere else, but at Sensei's house.

units.source_text: 按照约定，饭桌摆在客厅靠近走廊的地方，

en.t: As arranged, the dining table had been set near the corridor in the parlor,

units.source_text: 桌上铺着的浆得又厚又硬的花桌布，在灯光映照下更显得漂亮、洁净。

en.t: and the thickly starched, stiff patterned tablecloth spread over it looked all the prettier and cleaner in the lamplight.

units.source_text: 每次在先生家吃饭，碗筷必定放在像西餐馆似的白色亚麻桌布上，

en.t: Whenever I ate at Sensei's house, the bowls and chopsticks were always set on a white linen tablecloth like one in a Western restaurant,

units.source_text: 而且这桌布必定洗得雪白。

en.t: and that cloth was always washed to a pure white.
